main.badge: For freelancers who are done with scope creep
main.header: The scope you agreed to in the room,
main.description: Upload a client kickoff call. Scopelancer transcribes it, extracts the real project scope and deadlines, diagrams it, and drafts a strategic follow-up sequence in your own tone.

section_1.title: From an hour-long call to defensible artifact
section_1.description: Four deterministic stages. Each one streams back into your dashboard as it completes.

stage1.title: Upload the recording
stage1.description: Drop in the audio from your kickoff call — mp3, m4a, wav, webm.

stage2.title: Transcribe & parse
stage2.description: Groq Whisper transcribes; a strict schema captures scope, variables, and deadlines.

stage3.title: Diagram the scope
stage3.description: Claude Sonnet turns the parsed scope into a Mermaid architecture diagram.

stage4.title: Draft the follow-up
stage4.description: A multi-day email sequence in your own tone, ready to review and send.

benefit1.title: Strict structured output
benefit1.description: Every scope, deliverable, and deadline is validated against a schema — no vibes-based summaries.

benefit2.title: Streaming pipeline
benefit2.description: Results appear as each stage finishes — transcript, scope, diagram, emails.

benefit3.title: Pay only for what you use
benefit3.description: Prepaid credits metered against real audio minutes and tokens. Unused holds are refunded.
